speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. Please tell me, where exactly is your abdominal pain located, and how long has it been present?

speaker: Patient
text: 17-year-old female. The patient presents with a 5-day history of severe abdominal pain and cramping, accompanied by nausea and vomiting. She reports pain with urination and also experienced burning pain during sexual intercourse 3 days ago. She mentions being sexually active with one male partner, using condoms inconsistently.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the detailed history. Given your symptoms of dysuria and dyspareunia alongside severe abdominal pain, have you noticed any vaginal discharge, fever, or abnormal bleeding since the pain began? Also, did the condom break or slip during your last sexual encounter?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Severe abdominal pain and cramping. I also have Nausea, Vomiting, Pain with urination, Burning pain during intercourse.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Pelvic Inflammatory Disease (PID) secondary to Chlamydia trachomatis or Neisseria gonorrhoeae.

REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis, Urine Culture, Cervical Swab for NAAT (Chlamydia/Gonorrhea), and Pregnancy Test.
REQUEST IMAGES: Pelvic Ultrasound.
